title: C1 · Vision event (A -> B)
description: Published by vision-twin on MQTT topic miner/{miner_id}/vision about once per second (QoS 0). One message describes every registered tag the pipeline knows about in the latest analysed frame.

ts.description: Capture time of the analysed frame.

frame_hash.description: sha256 of the raw frame bytes, 0x-prefixed. Goes into the evidence hash; identical hashes over time mean a frozen camera.

frame_size.description: Frame dimensions in pixels, so bbox values can be interpreted.

plants.description: One entry per registered sticker of this miner (normally 20), including ones not currently seen (status missing/removed).

unknown_tag_ids.description: Marker IDs seen in the frame that are not in this miner's registered sticker set.

source.description: What produced the event: the Pi camera, the laptop fallback, a recorded clip, or the mock emitter.

species.description: Species enrolled for this tag (or 'unknown' if not enrolled).

species_conf.description: Plant-match score 0-1: similarity between the live crop and the enrolled feature vector. Low = plant swapped.

leaf_area_cm2.description: Visible leaf area, smoothed, converted to cm2 using the known marker size. 0 when not seen.

alive_score.description: Liveness 0-1 (NDVI primary, match/texture fallback). Low = plastic or dead plant.

ndvi.description: Optional raw mean NDVI of the plant crop (-1 to 1), for the twin's NDVI view.

bbox.description: Plant bounding box [x, y, w, h] in pixels of the analysed frame; null when the tag is not seen.

last_seen_ts.description: Last time this tag was detected.
